questions.questionText: hour 15 minutes You must answer on the multiple choice answer sheet. You will need: Multiple choice answer sheet Soft clean eraser Soft pencil (type B or HB is recommended) INSTRUCTIONS  There are forty questions on this paper. Answer all questions.  For each question there are four possible answers A, B, C and D. Choose the one you consider correct and record your choice in soft pencil on the multiple choice answer sheet.  Follow the instructions on the multiple choice answer sheet.  Write in soft pencil.  Write your name, centre number and candidate number on the multiple choice answer sheet in the spaces provided unless this has been done for you.  Do not use correction fluid.  Do not write on any bar codes.  You may use a calculator. INFORMATION  The total mark for this paper is 40.  Each correct answer will score one mark.  Any rough working should be done on this question paper.  The Periodic Table is printed in the question paper.  Important values, constants and standards are printed in the question paper.

3 The impurities in X do not react with hydrochloric acid. 7.4g of X is reacted with an excess of dilute hydrochloric acid. 0.050mol of the Group 2 metal chloride is produced. What is the identity of the Group 2 metal?

options.A: Mg B Ca C Sr D Ba

questions.questionText: Which of these samples of gas contains the same number of atoms as 1g of hydrogen gas?

options.A: 22g of carbon dioxide (M: CO , 44) r 2
options.D: 8g of ozone (M: O , 48) r 3

questions.questionText: This question is about the first ionisation energies of magnesium and neon. Which row is correct? type of electron removed first ionisation energy from Mg from Ne

options.A: Mg > Ne p s
options.D: Ne > Mg s p

questions.questionText: Arsenic forms a compound with fluorine. In this compound, the arsenic atom has no lone pair of electrons and there are no dative bonds. Selenium also forms a compound with fluorine. In this compound, the selenium atom has no lone pair of electrons and there are no dative bonds. In which compounds are there two different bond angles? (In this question, 180 bond angles should be ignored.)

options.A: both arsenic fluoride and selenium fluoride
options.D: neither arsenic fluoride nor selenium fluoride

The diagram shows the apparatus used to find the relative molecular mass of a volatile liquid. When 0.10g of a volatile liquid is injected into the syringe, all of the volatile liquid evaporates and the volume increases by 85cm3. The heater maintains a temperature of 400K and the experiment is carried out at a pressure of 101300Pa. syringe volatile liquid injected here thermometer heater If the vapour of the volatile liquid behaves as an ideal gas, which expression can be used to calculate the relative molecular mass of the liquid?

options.A: MgO C H Br Fe Al O

questions.questionText: The apparatus used to determine a value for the enthalpy of combustion of butan-1-ol is shown. The mass of 1.00cm3 of water is 1.00g. thermometer copper can 175 cm3 water butan-1-ol in burner initial mass of burner + butan-1-ol 58.34g initial temperature of water 17.6C final mass of burner + butan-1-ol 57.85g final temperature of water 41.1C butan-1-ol M = 74 r Which value, to three significant figures, for the enthalpy of combustion of butan-1-ol can be calculated from these data?

options.A: –114Jmol–1
options.D: –4540kJmol–1

questions.questionText: In the high temperatures of car engines, nitrogen reacts with oxygen to produce nitrogen monoxide.
In which reaction does the oxidation number of chlorine change by the largest amount?

options.A: 2KClO  2KCl + 3O

questions.questionText: Hydrogen is produced industrially from methane as shown in the equation. CH (g) + H O(g) CO(g) + 3H (g) Ho = +205kJmol–1
W moles of HNO undergoes a disproportionation reaction to produce U moles of HNO and
Gas X dissociates on heating to set up the following equilibrium. X(g) Y(g) + Z(g)

options.A: 6 p B 9 p C 36 p D 9p

questions.questionText: In the diagram, X is the Boltzmann distribution for the energies of the particles in a reaction and E is the activation energy for that reaction. A1 E E A2 A1 number of molecules Z X Y 0 molecular energy Which statement is correct?

options.A: E is the activation energy at a higher temperature. A2
options.B: E is the activation energy at a lower temperature. A2
options.C: Y is the Boltzmann distribution at a lower temperature.
options.D: Z is the Boltzmann distribution at a higher temperature.

questions.questionText: Magnesium, aluminium and silicon are elements in the Periodic Table. Each element forms an oxide. Which row is correct? MgO Al O SiO
Which statement correctly describes what happens when silicon tetrachloride is added to water?

options.A: The SiCl dissolves to give a neutral solution only.
options.B: The SiCl reacts to give an acidic solution only.
options.C: The SiCl reacts to give a precipitate and an acidic solution.
options.D: The SiCl reacts to give a precipitate and a neutral solution.

questions.questionText: X and Y are two elements from Period 3 of the Periodic Table. Element X has a higher electrical conductivity than element Y. Element Y has a higher melting point than element X. Which formula is a compound formed from element X and element Y?

options.A: MgS B Mg Si C NaCl D SiCl

questions.questionText: A sample consisting of 1.0mol of anhydrous calcium nitrate is completely decomposed by strong heating. What is the total amount of gas produced in this reaction?

options.A: 1.0mol B 2.0mol C 2.5mol D 3.0mol

questions.questionText: Steam is passed over heated magnesium to give compound J and hydrogen. What is not a property of compound J?

options.A: It has an M of 40.3. r
options.D: It is very soluble in water.

questions.questionText: Which statement is correct?

options.A: Hydrogen bromide reduces concentrated sulfuric acid to form sulfur dioxide gas.
options.B: Hydrogen bromide decomposes at a higher temperature than hydrogen chloride.
options.C: When hydrogen bromide gas is shaken with aqueous silver nitrate a yellow precipitate is formed.
options.D: When hydrogen bromide gas is bubbled through aqueous iodine the solution becomes colourless.

questions.questionText: ICl is made when Cl and I react together.
NH Cl reacts with NaOH in an aqueous solution. Which statement is correct?

options.A: The reaction gives rise to two different polar product molecules.
options.B: The bond angle in the nitrogen-containing species remains unchanged.
options.C: The ammonium ion acts as a base.
options.D: The oxidation state of nitrogen increases in the reaction.

questions.questionText: What is produced when 60g of nitrogen monoxide reacts with an excess of carbon monoxide in a catalytic converter?

options.A: 12g of carbon and 92g of nitrogen dioxide
options.B: 24g of carbon and 92g of nitrogen dioxide
options.C: 88g of carbon dioxide and 28g of nitrogen
options.D: 88g of carbon dioxide and 56g of nitrogen

questions.questionText: Which alkene shows geometric isomerism?

options.A: CH CH CH CH CH

questions.questionText: What is the correct name of the major product of the reaction of HBr with 3-ethylhex-3-ene?

options.A: 3-bromo-3-ethylhexane
options.D: 4-bromo-4-ethylhexane

questions.questionText: The alkane CH CH CH(CH ) undergoes free radical substitution with chlorine. No C–C bonds
What is involved in the mechanism of the reaction between aqueous NaOH and 1-bromobutane?

options.A: attack by a nucleophile on a carbon atom with a partial positive charge
options.B: heterolytic bond fission and attack by a nucleophile on a carbocation
options.C: homolytic bond fission and attack by an electrophile on a carbanion
options.D: homolytic bond fission and attack by a nucleophile on a carbocation

questions.questionText: But-2-ene reacts with cold dilute acidified KMnO to give product X. But-2-ene reacts with an excess of hot concentrated acidified KMnO to give product Y. Which statement about X and Y is correct?

options.A: Only one of X and Y reacts with 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine.
options.B: X and Y both react with sodium hydroxide.
options.C: X and Y both react with sodium metal.
options.D: Y reacts with LiAlH to give X.

questions.questionText: When heated with KOH dissolved in ethanol, halogenoalkanes can undergo an elimination reaction to form alkenes. What are the possible elimination products when 2-bromobutane is heated with KOH dissolved in ethanol?

options.A: CH CH=CHCH only

questions.questionText: Chloroethane can be used to make sodium propanoate. chloroethane  intermediate Q  sodium propanoate Intermediate Q is hydrolysed with boiling aqueous NaOH to give sodium propanoate. Which reagent would produce intermediate Q from chloroethane?

options.A: concentrated ammonia solution
options.D: potassium cyanide in ethanol

questions.questionText: Four different alcohols are treated with alkaline I (aq). Which row is correct? name of alcohol formulae of products

options.A: butan-2-ol CH COO– and CH CI

questions.questionText: The M of compound X is 88. r Compound X is heated under reflux with an excess of acidified potassium dichromate(VI) to produce compound Y. Compound Y reacts with compound X under suitable conditions to produce compound Z. The M r of compound Z is 172. What is compound X?

options.A: CH CH CHOHCH CH

questions.questionText: Butanedione, CH COCOCH , is a yellow liquid.
Which substance reacts with ethanoic acid to give the organic product with the highest M? r

options.A: lithium aluminium hydride
options.D: propan-2-ol

questions.questionText: A sample of propyl ethanoate is hydrolysed by heating under reflux with aqueous NaOH. The two organic products of the hydrolysis are separated, purified and weighed. Out of the total mass of products obtained, what is the percentage by mass of each product?
Which statement about PVC is correct?

options.A: Combustion products of PVC are very alkaline and harmful to breathe in.
options.B: The empirical formula of PVC is the same as the empirical formula of the monomer.
options.D: The repeat unit of PVC is (CH CCl ).

questions.questionText: Compound Q reacts separately with HCN and NaBH under suitable conditions. Both reactions produce an organic product with a chiral centre. What is compound Q?

options.A: butanone
options.D: propanone

questions.questionText: Compound X has the following properties. ● When 0.20mol of X undergoes complete combustion, 14.4dm3 of carbon dioxide is produced, measured under room conditions. ● X reacts with 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine reagent to give an orange crystalline product. ● X does not give a yellow precipitate with alkaline I (aq). What could be X?

options.A: hexan-3-one
options.D: propanone
